message: var V_name (id V_var) and the `decl` node binding it disagree: V_detail
why: vars[] and decl nodes are two views of one binding. The executor reserves the slot from vars[] but assigns it in the decl node; if they disagree, the variable is read from a slot that was never written.
fix: make var V_var.decl point at the `decl` node that assigns it
or drop the vars[] entry if the decl node no longer exists
